scope: Read-only inspection of the four existing native 720p performances and three silent derivatives. No paid/new AI generation, no render asset edits.

method.visual: Sampled 0/.5/1/2/.../9/end contact sheets of all four original clips; enlarged incoming and outgoing face comparisons. This is sampled source audit, not headset or full browser playback proof.
method.metrics: RGB mean absolute differences in fixed face/hand rectangles. Values support observed pose mismatches, not a validated perceptual score or motion-sickness measurement.

findings.observation: Initial question already shows right note-taking followed by left paper attention around 4.75-8s; current first listening clip repeats the same broad action sequence immediately afterwards. Silent tail reuse of the initial question during the same answer is an especially recognizable repeat.
findings.recommendation: Start a neutral interval after a speaking clip; retain session-wide gesture/source recency; do not re-use that question note-taking tail in the same answer.

findings.observation: The first .5s of the 3s experience derivative still contains a returning head pose. At derivative0s right-face MAE to initial reference was10.40 versus4.03 at.75s.
findings.recommendation: Play existing derivative from.75s (source7.75s), forward at1x. Retain2.25s; do not retime/morph.

findings.observation: Right-face MAE at neutral-plan0s was5.94 versus4.86 at.5s.
findings.recommendation: Play existing derivative from.5s (source7.5s), forward at1x. Retain2.5s.

findings.observation: Original listening7.3s still shows a slightly forward center head pose; it settles near9s. Question8s still has right head returning, settling by8.75s.
findings.recommendation: Use outgoing safe window start9.0s for original listening,8.75s for question,4.75s for question-tail. Existing experience8s may remain. Do not extend the dissolve beyond150ms to hide mismatch.

findings.observation: After offsets, P-to-E maximum face native-resolution MAE3.63, hands2.85; E-to-P max face5.03,hands2.79. Those transitions are lower-amplitude than original incoming E0s right-face jump~10.1. Neutral alternating repeats blinks/low motion, but avoids repeating large writing actions.
findings.recommendation: Prefer8-10s made of alternate2.5/2.25s neutral clips where needed over another conspicuous writing cycle. This adds cuts; preserve100-150ms fixed-view dissolve and review actual playback. Neutral source reuse after a different neutral interval should remain possible in answer2; banning it all would force repeated single-neutral loops.

Track note gesture usage across both answers. Prefer the least recently used note performance, require~24s source cooldown, and avoid starting a10s note performance with<9s answer budget remaining. Existing performances can reduce repetition, not eliminate it.

exampleExperienceTimeline.status: Proposed editorial example, not a measured runtime trace; omits loading, actual dissolve overlap, mic finalization and pauses.
exampleExperienceTimeline.writingBreakdown: Two embedded in spoken questions; original listening used once; initial-question writing tail reused once only in answer2, around42s after its first writing action.

limitations: No Quest headset or human nausea validation.
No continuous browser observation by this audit agent.
Native materials still contain repeated performances.
Mono film on room surfaces cannot supply true binocular person depth or tracked positional parallax.
720p to4K is existing local enlargement, not newly generated fine detail.
